paite: Jesu'n huai thute agen khit in anungzuite toh apawt ua, Kidron luita akan ua, huai ah huan khat a-om hi. Huai ah amah leh anungzuite alut uhi.
heading: Jesu Matna / (Mat 26.47-56; Mar 14.43-50; Luk 22.47-53)

paite: Huan amansak dingpa Judas in leng huai mun athei a; huai ah anungzuite toh Jesu ava tawlnga zelzel uhi.
Huchi in Judas in sepaih pawl, siampu liante leh Pharisaite kiang a om heutute api a, khawnvakte, meiselte, galvante tawi in huai ah ahong pai uhi.
Jesu'n atung a thil tung ding tengteng atheigige a, ava pawt a, akiang uah, "Kua ahia na zon uh?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Nazaret Jesu," chi in adawng uhi. Jesu'n akiang uah, "Keimah ka hi," achi hi.
Amansakpa Judas leng alak uah adingh a, "Keimah ka hi," achihtak in, anungtolh ua, lei ah apuk duam uhi.
Huan ama'n akiang uah, "Kua ahia na zon uh?" chi in adong nawn hi. Amau, "Nazaret Jesu," achi uhi.
Huan Jesu'n, "Keimah ka hi chih ka hon hilhta a; nou kei hon zong na hih uleh hiaite hoihtak in khah un," achi a adawng hi.
"Nang kei na hon piakte khat leng ka mangsak kei," chi a athugen atangtunna ding ahi.
Huan Simon Peter in anamsau vom adokkhia a siampu lianpen sikha asat a, abil taklam asatkhiaksak hi. Huai sikha min Malkas ahi.
Huchi in Peter kiang ah Jesu'n, "Na namsau apai ah siat in; Pa in nou ahon piak ka dawn kei dia hia?" achi hi.
Huchi in sepaih pawl leh Judate heutute'n Jesu aman ua, ahenta uhi.
Annas kiang ah api masa uh, amah Kaiapha sunghpa ahih ziak in. Kaiapha, huai kum a siampu lianpen ahi.
heading: Jesu Siampu Lian Ma Ah

paite: Kaiapha bel, mi tengteng sang a mi khat sih ahoihzaw chi a, Judate hanthawnpa ahi.
Huan Simon Peter in nungzui dang khat toh Jesu azui hi. Huai nungzuipa siampu lianpen meltheih ahi a, siampu lianpen huangsung intual ah, Jesu kiang ah alut sam hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Akitheihmohbawl / (Mat 26.69-70; Mar 14.66-68; Luk 22.55-57)

paite: Himahleh polam a kongkhak bul ah Peter adingh hi. Huchi in nungzui dang siampu lianpen meltheih khat ava pawt a, kongkhak ngaknu ahoupih a, Peter apilut hi.
Kongkhak ngak, nungak in Peter kiang ah, "Nang leng hiai mi nungzuite lak a pang sam na hi hia?" achi hi.
Ama'n, "Ka hi kei," achi hi. Sikhate leh heutute huai ah adingh uhi. Avot ziak in meihol in mei atoh ua, meilum a-awi uhi. Peter leng akiang uah a-om a, dingh kawm in meilum a-awi sam hi.
Siampu lianpen in Jesu anungzuite tanchin leh athusinsak adong hi.
heading: Siampu Lianpen In Jesu Thu Dong / (Mat 26.59-66; Mar 14.55-64; Luk 22.66-71)

paite: Jesu'n adawng a, akiang ah, "Khovel kiang ah vantang theih in, thu ka gen gige hi; sinagog, tempul leh Judate omkhawmnate ah thu ka hilh zel a, asim in bangmah ka gen kei.
Bang achia kei hon dong? Akiang ua ka thugen ka thuzate dong in, ngai in, amaute'n ka thugen athei uh akei hiam," achi hi.
Huan agentak in akiang a dingh heutu khat in Jesu abeng a, "Siampu lianpen hichibang in na dawng maw?" achi hi.
Jesu'n akiang ah, "Thudiklou gen ka hihleh, adiklouhna hon theisak in; himahleh, ka thugen dik ahihleh bang achia hon beng?" achi hi.
Huan Annas in hensa in siampu lianpen Kaiapha kiang ah asawl hi.
Simon Peter in dingh kawm in meilum a-awi hi. "Nang leng anungzuite lak a pang sam na hi hia?" achi uhi. Ama'n, "Ka hi kei," chi in akitheihmohbawl hi.
heading: Peter In Jesu Akitheihmohbawl Nawn / (Mat 26.71-75; Mar 14.69-72; Luk 22.58-62)

paite: Huan siampu lianpen sikha khat Peter in abil satkhiaksakpa sanggampa'n, akiang ah, "Huan ah ka hon mu kei maw?" achi hi.
Huchi in Peter in akitheih-mohbawl nawn a; huan ak akhuang pah hi.
Kaiapha inn a pan in Vaihawmna inn ah Jesu api nawn ua; huai zingsang ahi a; amau ahihleh Vaihawmna inn ah alut kei uh, alut un zaw buah in, Paikan Ankuanglui ane thei kei ding uhi.
heading: Pilat Ma ah Jesu / (Mat 27.1-2,11-14; Mar 15.1-5; Luk 23.1-5)

paite: Amaute kiang ah Pilat ava pawt a, "Hiai mi tung ah hekna bang ahia na neih uh?" achi hi.
Amau akiang ah, "Hiai migilou hi keileh na kiang ah ka hon pi kei ding uh," chi in adawng uhi.
Huan Pilat in akiang uah, "Nou pi unla, na dan bang un vai hawmsak un," achi hi. Judate'n akiang ah, "Kou thu in kuamah hihlup dan bang ahi kei," achi uhi.
Hiai thu asihdan ding, Jesu'n agen bang a atangtunna ding ahi.
Huchi in insung ah Pilat alut nawn a, Jesu asam a, akiang ah, "Judate' Kumpipa na hi hia?" achi hi.
Jesu'n, "Hiai ka tungtang thu nangmah lungsim puakkhiak a na gen hia, midang in hon hilh?" chi in adawng hi.
Pilat in, "Kei Juda mi ka hi a hia? Nangmah chipihte leh siampu liante'n ka kiang ah ahon pekhia ua ahi; thil bang ahia na hih?" chi in adawng hi.

Jesu'n, "Ka kumpi hihna hiai khovel ahi kei; ka kumpi hihna hiai khovel a hileh Judate kiang a piak a ka omlouhna ding in, ka sikhate'n adou ding uh. Himahleh ka kumpi hihna zaw hiai khovel a kipan ahi kei," chi in adawng hi.

Pilat in akiang ah, "Huchi, nang kumpipa na hi mawleh?" achi hi. Jesu'n, "Kumpipa ka hi na hon chi mah ve. Thutak theihsak ka piansan leh khovel a ka hong paisan ahi. Kuapeuh thutak a om peuhmah in ka thu asang uh," achi hi.
Pilat in akiang ah, "Thutak bang ahia?" achi hi. Huan huai thu agen khit in, Judate kiang ah ava pawt nawn a, akiang uah, "Bangmah agitlouhna ka mu kei," achi hi.
Himahleh Paikan Ankuangluina ah mi khat ka hon pawtsakna ding dan na nei uh; huchi in "Judate' Kumpipa hon pawtsak leng na ut uhia?" achi hi.
heading: Jesu Si Ding A Thutanna / (Mat 27.15-31; Mar 15.6-20; Luk 23.13-25)

paite: Amau akikou nawn ua, "Hiai mi hi kei henla, Barabbas pen hi zaw hen," achi uhi. Barabbas tuh suamhat ahi.
